name: Humanitix
description: Humanitix is a ticketing and event-management platform for publishing events, selling tickets, managing registrations, communicating with attendees, checking guests in and directing booking-fee profits to charity.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Humanitix public API key through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list one bounded event page or inspect one exact event without attendee, order, ticket or financial data.

credentialRequirements.name: HUMANITIX_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Humanitix public API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the key under Account > Advanced > Public API key and store it encrypted.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Humanitix event summaries and inspect one exact event without people, order or financial data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Humanitix event summaries from page one.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact Humanitix event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Orders, tickets, buyers, attendees, answers, access codes, donations, fees, payments and other sensitive fields are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block ticketing actions
blocked.description: Ticket check-in and every other event, order, ticket, tag or account mutation are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event reads run directly; people, financial, ticketing, pagination and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; account authority, fixed origin, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Humanitix event reads and sends the encrypted key only to the fixed production API origin.
Relay mounts two typed Humanitix event reads and sends the encrypted key only to the fixed production API origin.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates the public API key under Account > Advanced, enters it in Relay, then selects event-read capability and Safe or Dangerous policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Humanitix documents a public read-only API, customer-generated x-api-key authentication, owned/shared event access, 24-character event identifiers, 200 requests per minute and six months' breaking-change notice.
Humanitix documents the fixed https://api.humanitix.com production origin, HTTPS-only x-api-key requests and event, order, ticket and tag resources.
